chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Choosing Louis Armstrong over Lionel Hampton
summary: Joe Glaser asked whom he wanted to play with and he chose Armstrong, with whom he was like a buddy.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: O.K., so you said that - was Louis Armstrong playing with the Louis Russell band when you were with them at first?
Was Louis Armstrong playing with the Louis Russell band? Was he fronting the Louis Russell band when you were playing with him?

No, here's what happened, I was playing with Louis Russell and they made a decision. Louis Russell was playing in the (Apollo?) Theatre and Lionel Hampton was (there.) So Joe Glaser was back there and he asked me who did I want to play with, and I told him.
Oh dear, I don't have none of those dates.
Because in the late 30's Louis Armstrong fronted the Louis Russell band, didn't he?
I told Joe Glaser I wanted to play with Louis Armstrong. So that's the way it went. Lou and I were just like buddies...(!) So that's all I know.
